notes: Access: curl_cffi impersonate=chrome131 (per notes/203.md); homepage itself returned PerimeterX px-captcha 429 on 2 attempts but every deep-linked page fetched fine at ~5-8s pacing -- no tier-2/3 needed. Discovery: SSR mega-nav JSON on a working category page (chandeliers-c1859282.html) contains a top-level BlockBuilderTopLevelNavigationGroup named 'Best Sellers' linking to https://www.jossandmain.com/curated/best-of-the-best~ev388976.html; this group's own 'blocks' field is null (no dropdown children), i.e. Best Sellers is a single flat listing on this site, not a department-split concept. Opened the page and confirmed it is a genuine PLP: visible '445 Items' header, BlockBuilderBrowseResultCount browseResultCount=445, totalSKUCount=445, eventRoadsign 'Best of the Best', real BrowseGrid with pagination -- same block architecture (BlockBuilderBrowseTitleEvent/BlockBuilderBrowseResultCount, browsePageType:3) used by this project's already-validated New Arrivals PLP on the same site, giving high confidence this is a true merchandising listing, not editorial. Also found (same mega-nav JSON) a link labelled 'Best-Selling Furniture' at https://www.jossandmain.com/daily-sales/best-selling-furniture~e297782.html -- excluded: (1) it sits under a separate '/m/shop-sale' curated-navigation hub of time-boxed daily-sale events, not nested under the flat 'Best Sellers' group above; (2) robots.txt disallows /daily-sales/*.html for all user-agents, so it was not fetched. Checked: seo-category-sitemap~0.xml (166 URLs) and all 3 seo-keyword-sitemap shards (~104k URLs combined) for bestseller/best-sell/best-of-the-best slugs -- zero matches, confirming this curated page is not separately SEO-indexed, consistent with it being reachable only via on-site nav. Joss & Main is Wayfair-family (Next.js/BlockBuilderBrowse, same platform noted in notes/203.md for the category pass); its Bestsellers PLP lives at a /curated/<slug>~ev<eventId>.html URL, which is the same URL family AllModern/Birch Lane (also in this batch) likely expose their own merchandising events under -- worth checking there first.

rows.evidence: Visible page text "445 Items"; JSON browseResultCount:445 and totalSKUCount:445; eventRoadsign "Best of the Best"; site's own top-nav link text for this URL is "Best Sellers"
